Senses.Explanation: Distance doubled to totality, and the masters who grade a wrong turn by it. Xuedou Chongxian answers the monk who leaps from the way-is-near answer to having heard the unheard with the flat verdict that he is a thousand and ten thousand miles off, Shoushan Xingnian warns the assembly that at this point the eye must fix at once or it is a thousand and ten thousand miles off, like watching a horse through a window, Yuanwu Keqin writes to a patron that what the thousand sages secretly transmit stands more than wall-like ten-thousand fathoms, a thousand and ten thousand miles apart, yet the whole earth picked up holds not one dust of it, Chushi Fanqi sets the dharma with nothing to grasp, straightaway nothing-to-do, rest and cease, against one trampling step forward that lands a thousand and ten thousand miles off, and Yulin Tongxiu tells the assembly that where he truly serves them, even a thousand and ten thousand miles away is still counsel at their ear. Qianyan Yuanzhang tells the assembly that at Wuming's place there is only Wuming and no buddha-dharma, so to take the staff and the shout as a matter for discussion is to fall a thousand and ten thousand miles off, Tianyin Yuanxiu raises that saying and doubles the miss, since not discussing them is a thousand and ten thousand miles off too, Yongjue Yuanxian grades shout and staff as already second and third and any how-about-this on top as straight out a thousand and ten thousand miles, Liangting Jingting warns his correspondent that calling the inward quietude cessation-present is at once a thousand and ten thousand miles off, and Jiqi Hongchu sizes up pilgrims from the far provinces who cross a thousand and ten thousand miles and the lake itself and still do not know where the mountain is.
